name: Farco Plastics Supply - Montgomery
old_description: At Farco Plastics, we pride ourselves on being a leading provider of high quality plastics. We understand that when it comes to exterior signage and architectural applications, only the best will do. That's why we offer an extensive range of products that are perfect for any project. Our polycarbonate and PVC foam products are ideal for creating stunning signs that will grab attention and make a lasting impression. And our marine grade plastics are perfect for any project that will be exposed to salt water or other harsh conditions. Whatever your project, Farco Plastics has the right product for you.
about:
Farco Plastics Supply operates a facility in Montgomery, Alabama, at 577 Trade Center Street, serving as a plastics supplier and fabrication resource for customers across the Southeast. The location is managed by General Manager Wyatt Harvey and runs Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business stocks a broad line of engineering and specialty plastics, including ABS, HDPE, polycarbonate, PVC foam, and marine-grade materials, alongside digital print substrates, display-grade sheets, advanced glazing products, and professional framing materials. In addition to material supply, the Montgomery site provides custom fabrication: CNC routing, laser cutting, thermoforming, machining, edging, and assembly of turnkey panels.

Farco Plastics targets three primary markets. Its graphics and signage segment supports both digital and traditional sign makers. The industrial and manufacturing segment supplies material solutions to Alabama's diverse production base. The marine and specialty segment addresses saltwater and harsh-environment applications throughout the Southeast.

The company emphasizes its extensive inventory and specialized expertise as differentiators, positioning itself as a full-service partner for signage, industrial, and marine customers who need both material availability and in-house fabrication capability.
